scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:contract && pnpm test:verify
scripts.docker:prune: docker builder prune -f && docker image prune -f
scripts.k3d:up: k3d cluster get platform-cluster >/dev/null 2>&1 || k3d cluster create platform-cluster --servers 1 --agents 0 --k3s-arg "--disable=traefik@server:*" --port "8080:80@loadbalancer" --port "8443:443@loadbalancer" --wait && kubectl config use-context k3d-platform-cluster
scripts.helm: helm repo add traefik https://traefik.github.io/charts --force-update && helm repo update && helm upgrade --install traefik traefik/traefik --create-namespace --namespace traefik --set ports.web.exposedPort=80 --wait
scripts.skaffold: pnpm k8s:secrets && pnpm docker:base && scripts/with-buildkit.sh skaffold dev --cache-artifacts=true --cleanup=true
scripts.skaffold:reset: pnpm k8s:secrets && pnpm docker:base && scripts/with-buildkit.sh skaffold dev --cache-artifacts=false --cleanup=true
